report.incidentSummary: On 2026-09-23 around 09:30 IST (04:00 UTC), users reported mutual fund values and P&L in their portfolios were unchanged since yesterday. Investigation revealed that the nightly mutual fund NAV ingestion job (nav-import) triggered by job-scheduler at 23:30 IST on 2026-09-22 (18:00 UTC) failed due to an Out-Of-Memory (OOM) kill in the market-data-service worker container when staging NAV rows. Zero NAVs were committed for trading day 2026-09-22, causing market-data-service and portfolio-service to continue serving stale NAV data from 2026-09-21.
report.rootCauseStatement: During nightly NAV ingestion on 2026-09-22 at 18:03:24 UTC, the market-data-service nav-import worker process exceeded its 512Mi memory limit (OOMKilled) while staging 14,302 rows from NAVAll.txt, rolling back the database transaction with 0 NAVs committed and leaving market-data-service serving stale 2026-09-21 mutual fund NAVs.

hypotheses.cause: The market-data-service nav-import worker process was OOMKilled (limit 512Mi) while staging 14,302 rows from NAVAll.txt, rolling back the transaction and committing 0 NAVs for trading day 2026-09-22.
hypotheses.rationale: Execution logs and metrics confirm the scheduled nav-import job started at 18:00:00 UTC on 2026-09-22, downloaded NAVAll.txt, hit 96% memory at 6,210 rows, and was OOMKilled at 18:03:24 UTC with exit code 1. No retries succeeded, causing nav_age_s to increase past 35 hours and portfolio-service to report stale NAVs from 2026-09-21.

hypotheses.cause: Cache configuration change CHG-48221 increasing ttl.nav from 3600s to 21600s prevented updated NAV values from reaching portfolio-service.
hypotheses.rationale: While CHG-48221 occurred at 03:25 UTC (08:55 IST), the underlying market-data-service had not ingested any new NAVs since 2026-09-21 due to the previous night's ingestion failure at 18:03 UTC. Portfolio-service logged stale NAV warnings prior to and independent of the cache change.

hypotheses.cause: Upstream AMFI feed degradation published an abnormally oversized NAVAll.txt file that caused consumer buffer saturation.
hypotheses.rationale: The AMFI feed file download succeeded normally (2041 KB, 14,302 rows) in ~48 seconds without feed corruption or connection timeouts; the failure occurred internally in market-data-service's memory handling during row staging.

facts.statement: job-scheduler triggered nav-import at 2026-09-22T18:00:00.000Z (run_58a35a02), which failed with exit code 1 at 2026-09-22T18:06:00.000Z.
job-scheduler metric jobs_failed spiked to 0.2 count/min at 2026-09-22T18:05:00.000Z.

market-data-service nav-import worker downloaded NAVAll.txt (2041 KB, 14,302 rows) and was OOMKilled at 18:03:24.000Z after hitting 96% of its 512Mi memory limit at row 6,210, rolling back with 0 NAVs committed.
market-data-service metric nav_age_s monotonically increased from 82,740s at 2026-09-22T17:00:00.000Z to 126,960s (~35.3 hours) at 2026-09-23T05:15:00.000Z without resetting.
portfolio-service logged 107 warnings during market hours stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for X holdings (nav_date=2026-09-21); showing last available NAV'.
portfolio-service metric price_age_s remained steady around 2 seconds, and valuation_errors remained at baseline noise (mean 1.08/min).
cache hit rate remained steady between 93% and 97% across all keyspaces and evictions remained at ~38/min.
Configuration change CHG-48221 raised ttl.nav from 3600s to 21600s on cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z (08:55 IST).

inferences.statement: The portfolio-service calculations and valuations were executing correctly without error, but were using stale market data because market-data-service never committed NAVs for 2026-09-22.
CHG-48221 did not trigger the stale values incident because market-data-service itself already held stale NAVs dated 2026-09-21 prior to the cache TTL modification.
The unbuffered row staging implementation in market-data-service accumulates entire NAV batches in memory, exceeding the allocated 512Mi container limit when processing full AMFI releases.

assumptions.statement: The nav-import worker process was scheduled with a hard container memory limit of 512Mi without sufficient headroom or swap space.

timeline.event: job-scheduler triggers scheduled job nav-import (run_58a35a02) on market-data-service.
market-data-service downloads NAVAll.txt (2041 KB, 14,302 rows) from amfi-nav-feed and begins in-memory staging.
nav-import worker process reaches 96% memory limit at 6,210 rows and is OOMKilled; transaction rolls back with 0 NAVs committed.
job-scheduler logs nav-import failure with exit code 1; jobs_failed metric spikes.
Config change CHG-48221 increases ttl.nav keyspace TTL from 3600s to 21600s on cache.
Users open portfolios during market open; portfolio-service serves holdings valued using stale 2026-09-21 NAVs and logs staleness warnings.
Incident INC-5648 opened by On-call SRE reporting mutual fund values not updating.

confidence.rationale: Direct log records and metrics in market-data-service and job-scheduler establish the exact time, cause (OOMKilled at 512Mi limit), and impact (0 NAVs committed, nav_age_s exceeding 35 hours) of the failure. Downstream portfolio-service logs confirm mutual funds were priced against 2026-09-21 NAVs.

gaps.description: Kubernetes manifest and pod resource limits for market-data-service worker were not directly inspected via deployment config tools.
gaps.impact: Low; application logs explicitly recorded the 512Mi memory limit and OOMKilled signal.

recommendedActions.action: Trigger an immediate manual re-run of the nav-import job with a temporary memory limit increase or run it in an adequately sized worker instance to import 2026-09-22 NAVs.
recommendedActions.rationale: Committing the missing NAV data will update market-data-service, reset nav_age_s, and resolve stale portfolio valuations.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service logs for 'nav-import completed', verify nav_age_s drops below 3600s, and confirm portfolio-service warning logs stop.

recommendedActions.action: Flush the 'nav' keyspace in cache once NAVs are committed.
recommendedActions.rationale: Because CHG-48221 extended the nav keyspace TTL to 6 hours, stale 2026-09-21 NAV entries may remain cached until their TTL expires.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify cache keys for mutual fund NAVs reflect updated values matching market-data-service.

recommendedActions.action: Refactor the nav-import staging parser to use streaming/chunked database inserts rather than loading all 14,302 rows into memory at once, and increase the container memory limit to at least 1Gi.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents future OOMKills as the number of AMFI mutual fund schemes grows.
recommendedActions.verification: Run a staging test with full NAVAll.txt files under a 512Mi memory profile and monitor memory peak utilization.

recommendedActions.action: Implement an alert on job-scheduler jobs_failed for nav-import and a staleness alert on market-data-service when nav_age_s exceeds 26 hours.
recommendedActions.rationale: Failure of the nightly 23:30 IST batch went unnoticed until users reported stale values the next morning at 09:30 IST.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify alert trigger rules in the monitoring dashboard for nav_age_s > 93600s.
